claim: Forming a NCCL ring among exactly 5 GPUs produces significant NUMA/congestion effects, and the authors explicitly recommend avoiding 5-GPU configurations.
stance_target: a 5-GPU DDP ring is a neutral choice on a PCIe fabric
scope_conditions: NCCL ring over PCIe/NVLink on DGX-1/DGX-2 class nodes
quoted_support: the NUMA effects appear quite signiﬁcant with 5 GPUs, implying that there may be a congestion when forming a NCCL ring among 5 GPUs. One should avoid adopting 5 GPUs in their application setup.

claim: PCIe shows a novel 'anti-locality' NUMA effect: nearby GPU pairs can deliver LOWER bandwidth than remote pairs, and it appears only for bandwidth, not latency.
stance_target: PCIe GPU-to-GPU bandwidth is not uniform across slot pairs
quoted_support: The PCIe NUMA effect here is an interesting novel observation: it de-scribes a scenario that nearby access presenting lower performance than remote access. We label such a NUMA effect as "anti-locality".

claim: The PCIe anti-locality effect appears for messages larger than 64 KB in bidirectional bandwidth measurements.
stance_target: PCIe path asymmetry only bites at LLM-scale message sizes
quoted_support: when message size is larger than 64KB, the PCIe anti-locality effect appears: PCIe-remote access delivers higher bidirection bandwidth than PCIe-neighbors (L1 & L2).

claim: PCIe latency is essentially uniform across GPU pairs - same through one PCIe switch, across a local CPU socket, or across the QPI bridge - so PCIe has no NUMA effect in latency.
stance_target: PCIe latency is topology-insensitive while bandwidth is not
quoted_support: the communication latency for accessing different pairs of GPUs via PCIe are similar, implying that no NUMA effects appear in latency through PCIe.

claim: NVLink latency is ~9 us for directly connected GPUs and rises ~2x (P100) or ~3x (V100) when a routing hop is required.
stance_target: NVLink latency depends on topology in a way PCIe latency does not
quoted_support: For nodes that are directly connected, the latency is around 9µs; for nodes that require manual routing, the latency is increased by about 2x for P100-DGX-1 and 3x for V100-DGX-1.

claim: On a 2-GPU NV-SLI system, latency is ~5 us local, ~8 us over NV-SLI, and ~13 us over PCIe.
stance_target: PCIe adds ~8 us of latency over a direct NV-SLI link for a 2-GPU pair
quoted_support: there are three latency levels: local access which is about 5µs; NV-SLI access to the opposite GPU which is about 8µs; and PCIe access to the opposite GPU, which is about 13µs.

claim: NCCL collective bandwidth saturates at ~16 MB on PCIe but ~256 MB on NVLink for 8 GPUs - an order-of-magnitude difference in the message size needed to reach peak.
stance_target: PCIe collectives reach peak bandwidth at far smaller messages than NVLink
quoted_support: for PCIe, CL-bandwidth saturates at about 224 = 16MB; whereas for NVLink, band-width saturates around 228 = 256MB.

claim: On a 2-GPU SLI system both PCIe and NV-SLI collective bandwidth saturate at ~1 MB.
stance_target: message-size threshold for collective saturation on small GPU counts
quoted_support: Both PCIe and NV-SLI bandwidth start to saturate at about 220 = 1MB.

claim: NVSwitch delivers 50 GB/s bidirectional per link, 300 GB/s via a single NVSwitch hop, and 2.4 TB/s baseboard-to-baseboard bisection on DGX-2.
quoted_support: GPUs on the same baseboard at a full bandwidth of 50 GB/s × 6 switches =300 GB/s via a single NVSwitch hop

claim: NVLink's advantage over PCIe is bandwidth, not latency.
stance_target: PCIe is competitive on latency but not on bandwidth
quoted_support: choosing one interconnect over the others (e.g., NVLink shows strong advantage on bandwidth rather than latency over PCIe)

claim: A faster interconnect alone barely lifts application speedup unless the CPU-centric master-slave programming model is replaced or communication control moves to the GPU (e.g. NVSHMEM).
stance_target: upgrading the fabric alone fixes multi-GPU scaling
quoted_support: without (i) replacing the underlying CPU-centric master-slave programming model by a more distributed parallelization model, or (ii) migrating the communication master role to a GPU (e.g., offloading GPU communication control from CPU to GPU via techniques such as NVSHMEM), optimized inter-GPU communication via faster intra-node GPU interconnect such as NVLinks can hardly become significant enough to lift the entire application's speedup.

claim: Employing NVLink introduces its own overheads - enabling/disabling peer access, routing, and NCCL initialization.
quoted_support: employing NVLink (either P2P or CL) introduces additional overhead (e.g., enable/disable peer access, routing, NCCL initialization, etc).

claim: PCIe, NVLink-V1 and NVLink-V2 all show strong NUMA effects, while NVSwitch and NV-SLI show uniform memory access (UMA).
stance_target: PCIe-attached GPU pairs are not interchangeable performance-wise
quoted_support: Among the ﬁve types of intra-node GPU interconnect techniques, PCIe, NVLink-V1 and V2 show strong NUMA effect in the tested platforms, due to various reasons including topology, position, connectivity, routing, sharing, chipset, etc. NVSwitch and NV-SLI show UMA.

claim: All tested platforms mix more than one interconnect type, and those networks can work exclusively, concurrently or cooperatively - so interconnect heterogeneity must be handled explicitly.
stance_target: complexity of tuning collectives on heterogeneous intra-node fabrics
scope_conditions: DGX-1, DGX-2, Summit, SummitDev, SLI system
quoted_support: All the tested platforms incorporate more than one type of interconnect network. These networks have their own characteristics and can work exclusively, concurrently, or cooperatively, depending on the system design.

claim: NCCL delivers better communication efficiency than MPI on all tested platforms, per the authors' evaluation.
stance_target: NCCL is the right collective library baseline for GPU training
quoted_support: integrating NCCL into MPI, as it is shown that NCCL delivers better communication efﬁciency than MPI on all-

stance_target: evidentiary basis of the interconnect claims

quoted_support: we ﬁll the gap by conducting a thorough evaluation on ﬁve latest types of modern GPU interconnects: PCIe, NVLink-V1, NVLink-V2, NVLink-SLI and NVSwitch, from six high-end servers and HPC platforms
